comment: Canonical improvement-dimension vocabulary (SSOT). Prose lives in docs/concepts/DIMENSIONS.md. Both test-genie findings and skill target_dimensions declarations map into this vocabulary; the controller's selection matches the two. Edit here only — the Go vocabulary, the anti-drift tests, and the docs all derive from this file. testgenie_source_map keys are architecture.v1.FindingSource proto enum NAMES (UNSPECIFIED excluded); testgenie_phase_map keys are test-genie catalog phase names (keep in lockstep with ValidPhaseNames). An unmapped or new source/phase fails the anti-drift test.

dimensions.description: Package/file placement and screaming-architecture (where code lives).
CLI/API manifest and binding contract gaps (cli-health).
Rendered UI behavior — smoke flows and playbook regressions.
Accessibility (a11y) conformance. No test-genie producer in v0; skill-supplied.
Automated test presence and quality (unit and integration phases).
Test-coverage levels. No test-genie producer in v0; skill-supplied.
Vulnerabilities, leaked secrets, and SAST findings. Produced by the test-genie `security` phase, which delegates to the security-health scenario.
Bundle size, latency, and web-vitals regressions.
PRD / operational-target completion (progress). Measured via gap metrics, not findings.

Measure coverage of stateful domains: each persisted-entity domain declares a named, typed, parameterized analytical query (or is waived). Produced by the test-genie `measures` phase, which delegates to the measures-health scenario.

Protocol Buffer contract organization, generated-artifact sync, transport-world clarity, and scenario-scoped proto-surface facts. Produced by the test-genie `proto` phase, which delegates to proto-health.
